title: How Quickly Can Diet Lower Cholesterol Levels?

competitorCoverage: Top-ranking articles about cholesterol for adults typically cover the definition of cholesterol types (HDL vs. LDL), healthy target ranges (total cholesterol under 200 mg/dL, LDL under 100 mg/dL), and the cardiovascular risks of elevated levels including heart attack and stroke. To compete, new content must address age-specific thresholds, medication decision-making criteria, and the distinction between lifestyle-only management versus pharmaceutical intervention.
